entities.summary: Yevhen Petrovych Perebyinis, is a Ukrainian diplomat and politician who is currently the deputy minister of foreign affairs since 27 July 2022. who was the Ambassador of Ukraine to the Czech Republic from 23 January 2017 to 9 July 2022.
